name: Novo Nordisk
thesis: Held under a REVISED thesis (the original 20%+ GLP-1 growth thesis broke on US pricing). The bet now: 2026 revenue decline comes in BETTER than the -4% to -12% CER guide and better than Street, on solid pricing and/or volume - driven by oral Wegovy (genuinely market-expansionary; beating at launch), international expansion, share defense in select segments, next-gen pipeline (CagriSema NDA, amycretin), and a stable insulin base. View: the 2026 reset is a price-driven trough, not the structural top. This is explicitly a VOLUME + orals-expansion bet that must clear a falling-net-price curve (Medicare IRA cuts ~70% from list effective 2027).
verdict: Watch (held under revised thesis; original GLP-1-growth thesis broke on pricing)
key_driver: Global GLP-1 script volume vs price decline + patent extensions in EM + share defense vs Lilly

tier_1_kpis.name: 2026 CER revenue vs guidance and consensus (PRIMARY thesis bar)
tier_1_kpis.current: FY26 guide -4% to -12% CER (narrowed up from -5% to -13%); Q1'26 beat consensus; US ops -11% CER on lower realized price
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Actual CER revenue worse than the guidance midpoint AND/OR worse than consensus (the thesis is to BEAT the lowered bar)

tier_1_kpis.name: Oral Wegovy (oral semaglutide 25mg) uptake
tier_1_kpis.current: ~$354M Q1'26, ~2x estimates, 2M+ scripts - the strongest-ever GLP-1 volume launch; the market-expansion engine
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Oral Wegovy scripts stall, OR Lilly orforglipron (no food restrictions) takes the oral share before Novo scales it

tier_1_kpis.name: US net price / realization
tier_1_kpis.current: US ops -11% CER Q1'26 on price; Medicare IRA negotiated ~70% off list for Ozempic/Wegovy effective 2027
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Net-price decline accelerates beyond plan (price compression overwhelms volume)

tier_1_kpis.name: Global GLP-1 script (TRx) volume growth — diabetes + obesity combined
tier_1_kpis.current: TBD — requires external data source (IQVIA / sell-side aggregation / transcript readouts)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <15% global TRx growth (slowing market = structural bear case; volume is the thesis)

tier_1_kpis.name: Wegovy + Ozempic units/scripts vs CER price/unit decline (split disclosure)
tier_1_kpis.current: Wegovy +134% FY25 sales (CER); Ozempic Q4'25 +1% CER (units flat-ish, price compressed)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Volume growth <15% AND price decline >20% (price compression overwhelming volume — thesis broken)

tier_1_kpis.name: Novo GLP-1 market share (diabetes vs Lilly tirzepatide; obesity vs Zepbound)
tier_1_kpis.current: TBD — diabetes share historically ~55%+; obesity LOSING US share - Mounjaro 23.4% vs Wegovy 16.5% of GLP-1 TRx; Zepbound US +79% while Novo US fell
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Obesity share loss >300bps in 2 consecutive Qs, OR diabetes share <40%

tier_1_kpis.name: Patent extension wins in 2026 LOE markets (CN, IN, BR, CA)
tier_1_kpis.current: Patents expiring 2026 in CN/IN/BR/CA — extension status TBV
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: LOE proceeds without successful extension in any 2 of the 4 markets
tier_1_kpis.source: annual report IP disclosures + jurisdiction patent registers (see directives/nvo_external_sources.md)

tier_1_kpis.name: CagriSema regulatory milestones
tier_1_kpis.current: NDA filed with FDA; Redefine 1: 91.9% achieved >=5% weight loss vs 31.5% placebo
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: NDA rejected, label restricted, or follow-on trial readouts disappoint
tier_1_kpis.source: FDA approval calendar + Novo press releases

nuance.bear_case: It is a PRICE problem more than a volume problem: 2026 guide is -4% to -12% sales, US -11% in Q1 on price, and Medicare IRA cuts Ozempic/Wegovy ~70% from list effective 2027 (MFN/net-price pressure on top). Share is also moving the wrong way in the US - Mounjaro 23.4% vs Wegovy 16.5% of GLP-1 TRx, Zepbound US +79% while Novo US fell - and Lilly's oral orforglipron (no food/water restrictions, likely cheaper small molecule) threatens to cap Novo's oral first-mover window to ~12-18 months. CagriSema's REDEFINE 1 landed at 22.7% weight loss, short of the ~25% bar the market wanted for clear superiority over tirzepatide. The CEO departed under duress after the ~50% drawdown and the board is reconstituting. 'Too draconian' requires being right on net PRICE, not just volume.
nuance.adversarial_take: CagriSema is 12-18 months from meaningful revenue under optimistic timelines, AND Lilly retatrutide could pre-empt any clean CagriSema launch window. Holding requires conviction that the 2026 trough is single-cycle pricing, not the start of a multi-year volume-share-price compression spiral.
nuance.stress_test: If 2026 actuals come in worse than -13% CER guide AND Wegovy Q-over-Q volumes decelerate AND Lilly retatrutide approval comes through, the position may need to be cut even before CagriSema readouts.

data_note: Novo reports in DKK at constant exchange rates (CER); the universal USD-based break rules are FX-distorted - judge the thesis on CER growth vs guide/consensus, not USD.
thesis_breakers_qualitative: Two consecutive Qs of CER revenue worse than -13% guide
Patent LOE proceeds in >=2 of CN/IN/BR/CA without extension
Wegovy QoQ volume decline (demand-driven, not supply)
CagriSema NDA rejected or label restricted
Diabetes share loss to Lilly tirzepatide accelerating below 40%
external_data_dependencies: IQVIA / Symphony Health script-volume data (paid) OR transcript-extracted volume commentary
FDA Orange Book + EPO Patent Register + jurisdiction-specific patent registers (free, scrape-able)
Sell-side share data (paid) OR derived from competitor (LLY) earnings disclosures

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

business_model_rules.narrative: Revenue YoY < 12% for 2Q — sub-cycle floor for a name with Wegovy supply ramp; sub-12 means GLP-1 share is being lost.
Op margin < 30% for 2Q — NVO runs 35-45% historically; sub-30 means Wegovy capacity capex is no longer being absorbed into operating leverage.
GM < 75% for 2Q — pricing/cost mix degrading; biologics should sustain low-80s.
Capex/Revenue > 30% for 2Q — Wegovy capacity buildout was the thesis through FY26; sustained >30% past FY27 means capex is no longer cycling down with capacity in place.
